description: This is a test class for the WizardPageEnableKeyboardFragment in the Android application, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of the fragment related to enabling the keyboard, UI updates, and content observer management.

classes.name: WizardPageEnableKeyboardFragmentTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the WizardPageEnableKeyboardFragment's behavior in enabling the keyboard and managing content observers.

methods.name: setupWizard
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by disabling the keyboard via shadow.

methods.name: testKeyboardNotEnabled
methods.description: Verifies the UI state when the keyboard is not enabled.

methods.name: testClickToEnableReachesSettings
methods.description: Tests that clicking the link opens the input method settings.

methods.name: testClickedSkipped
methods.description: Verifies that skipping the setup proceeds to the main settings activity.

methods.name: testKeyboardEnabled
methods.description: Verifies the UI state when the keyboard is enabled.

methods.name: testSettingsObserverRemovedOnDestroy
methods.description: Ensures content observers are removed when the fragment is destroyed.

methods.name: testSettingsObserverRemovedOnReallyLongWait
methods.description: Checks content observer removal after a long wait period.

methods.name: testSettingsObserverRemovedOnRestart
methods.description: Verifies content observer management across activity restart.

methods.name: testSettingsObserverReturnsToActivityOnTrigger
methods.description: Tests that enabling the keyboard triggers a restart of the activity.

methods.name: testSettingsObserverDoesNotReturnToActivityOnTriggerIfNotEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that no restart occurs if the keyboard is not enabled after trigger.
